THESIS: The recipient sees their current access conditions and can connect or ask for renewal from one cabinet.
OWN-WORLD: Existing Living line system; compact light surfaces, cobalt actions, meaningful amber/rose notifications.
STORY: Sign in with owner-issued username/password; retain login if desired; inspect account conditions and warnings; copy/import subscription or contact owner; optionally change password after confirming current credentials; logout.
FIRST VIEWPORT: Fixed-size account heading, named access status, exact date, remaining term and traffic; mobile stacks the two condition panels.
BEHAVIOR: Separate HttpOnly recipient sessions; hashed passwords and session tokens, trusted Origin and logout CSRF, bounded failed attempts. Admin issues/reset credentials; reset/rename/archive revoke user sessions. Existing bearer links stay compatible. Self-service password change rotates the current session, preserves its expiry and remembered preference, and revokes all other sessions; five incorrect current-password attempts are allowed per 15 minutes.
FORM: Local extension of established identity; no concept seed or new image comp required.
constraints: Owner-issued credentials; no public signup, payment or fake password recovery.
Passwords shown only in issuance/reset UI; never repeated in ordinary reads.
Preserve VPN keys, data, warnings and stopped-access inspection.
Remembered login lasts up to 30 days; unremembered server sessions up to12h.
Legacy personal-link entry remains available, so bearer links remain secrets.
Self-service password updates require current password, matching 12+ character new password, a cookie session and CSRF; bearer links are insufficient.
